title: Underwater hockey equipment suppliers: curated starter directory
scope: A focused, non-exhaustive directory of 12 supplier websites across ten countries. Primary-source product presence is verified to the access level recorded; no supplier is endorsed or independently audited.

methodology.seedReuse: Reused and rechecked supplier leads from the existing coaching/equipment research, then resolved geography and added selected manufacturers and regional suppliers.
methodology.activeMeaning: A supplier site or primary indexed catalog presents relevant products or a buying route. This is not proof of current legal trading status, order acceptance, inventory or fulfilment.
methodology.verification: Opened public primary sources where possible. Separately label indexed-only evidence, failed pages, and challenges. Access date is not publication or product-update date.
methodology.canadaPriority: Canadian supplier first, then suppliers with relevant official regional or international delivery evidence. Country selection or currency display does not prove delivery.
methodology.noTransactions: No messages, accounts, carts, purchases, uploads or publishing were performed.

publicNotice: Supplier listings are a starting point, not endorsements. Confirm fit, current rules, stock, final delivered cost, taxes, production times and return terms before ordering. Ask your club about loan gear and try-on opportunities.
editorialRules: Use original directory descriptions only; no copied product photos, logos, reviews or vendor marketing paragraphs.
Do not publish prices or stock from this research. No live-stock or checkout claim is authorized by this dataset.
Do not turn a worldwide statement into a guaranteed Canadian delivery badge; retain the recorded qualifier.
Equipment categories mean products were listed, not that all are in stock, appropriate for every player, or legal in every event.
Keep custom orders distinct from standard size, colour or handedness selections.
For goal and club orders, obtain product-specific freight and pool-operator approval. Vendor claims do not replace current equipment rules.
Do not show a map pin more precise than verified country without new location verification.

categoryVocabulary.fins: Fins, hockey blades or foot-pocket systems; see description
categoryVocabulary.club_equipment: Explicit school, club or quantity equipment offers

importantCorrections.detail: Country is United States based on the official business contact address, superseding conflicting third-party labels.
ASAP reports Canadian manufacture of acquired Bentfish Armoury designs from 2025. This does not establish the status of every former Bentfish reseller.
Goal product listing offers both leasing and purchase; its base displayed amount must not be represented as a completed purchase quote.

coverageGaps: No Asia-based supplier was sufficiently verified in this focused pass.
Canadian destination-specific evidence is strongest for ASAP; several others make broader regional or worldwide statements only.
Most suppliers have no verified formal bespoke or club-order program; unknown is not a refusal to supply.
